li.label: a filthy room
li.description: The bench in that room was sticky, and I didn't want to know what with.

li.label: a cold room
li.description: The cold gets in through the walls. I could see my breath while I worked.

li.label: a stifling room
li.description: It's like an oven in there, and the air doesn't move.

li.label: an animal in my bed
li.description: One of the animals has been sleeping on my bed. The blanket is all hair.

li.label: building work by my bed
li.description: They're building right next to where I sleep. Hammering from dawn to dusk.

li.label: vermin in the house
li.description: There's a wild animal getting into the rooms. I heard it scratching about all evening.

li.label: a bare earth floor
li.description: My room is bare earth. Everything I own is gritty with it.
